course.title: Assistant Baking Technician
course.awarding_body: Food Industry Capacity and Skill Initiative (FICSI)
entry_requirements: Grade 8 pass; 3 years of relevant experience in the Food Industry.
Previous relevant qualification at NSQF Level 2.5; 1.5 years of experience in the Food Industry.
Previous relevant qualification at NSQF Level 2; 3 years of experience in the Food Industry.
course.source_publisher: National Qualifications Register (NCVET); qualification file submitted by FICSI

facts.text_en: Bake products, maintain consistent quality, follow standard operating procedures, and operate ovens in coordination with the proof box and production unit.
facts.text_mr: उत्पादने भाजणे, त्यांची गुणवत्ता एकसारखी राखणे, ठरलेल्या कार्यपद्धती पाळणे आणि प्रूफ बॉक्स व उत्पादन युनिटच्या समन्वयाने ओव्हन चालवणे.
facts.source_publisher: Food Industry Capacity and Skill Initiative (FICSI), qualification file approved by NSQC

facts.text_en: Alternative entry route: Grade 10 pass; no experience required.
facts.text_mr: पर्यायी प्रवेश मार्ग: इयत्ता १० वी उत्तीर्ण; अनुभव आवश्यक नाही.
facts.source_publisher: Food Industry Capacity and Skill Initiative (FICSI), qualification file approved by NSQC

facts.text_en: Alternative entry route: Grade 8 pass plus 3 years of relevant Food Industry experience.
facts.text_mr: पर्यायी प्रवेश मार्ग: इयत्ता ८ वी उत्तीर्ण आणि अन्न उद्योगातील ३ वर्षांचा संबंधित अनुभव.
facts.source_publisher: Food Industry Capacity and Skill Initiative (FICSI), qualification file approved by NSQC

facts.text_en: Alternative entry route: previous relevant NSQF Level 2.5 qualification plus 1.5 years of Food Industry experience.
facts.text_mr: पर्यायी प्रवेश मार्ग: संबंधित NSQF स्तर २.५ पात्रता आणि अन्न उद्योगातील १.५ वर्षांचा अनुभव.
facts.source_publisher: Food Industry Capacity and Skill Initiative (FICSI), qualification file approved by NSQC

facts.text_en: Alternative entry route: previous relevant NSQF Level 2 qualification plus 3 years of Food Industry experience.
facts.text_mr: पर्यायी प्रवेश मार्ग: संबंधित NSQF स्तर २ पात्रता आणि अन्न उद्योगातील ३ वर्षांचा अनुभव.
facts.source_publisher: Food Industry Capacity and Skill Initiative (FICSI), qualification file approved by NSQC

facts.text_en: Minimum age listed in the qualification file: 16 years.
facts.text_mr: पात्रता फाइलमध्ये नमूद केलेले किमान वय: १६ वर्षे.

facts.text_en: Published progression pathway: Baking Technician → Plant Biscuit Production Specialist (NSQF Level 4).
facts.text_mr: प्रकाशित प्रगतीचा मार्ग: बेकिंग तंत्रज्ञ → प्लांट बिस्किट उत्पादन विशेषज्ञ (NSQF स्तर ४).
